Balaji G vs Food Safety And Standards Authority Of ... on 4
March, 2024
Author: Tushar Rao Gedela 
Bench: Tushar Rao Gedela  $~17  * IN THE HIGH COURT OF DELHI AT NEW DELHI  + W.P.(C) 1970/2023 & CM APPL. 7536/2023  BALAJI G   Th  
 ve  FOOD SAFETY AND STANDARDS  AUTHORITY OF INDIA AND ANR   Th  
 
 
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE TUSHAR RAO GEDELA  OR % 04.03.2024 (The proceeding has been conducted through Hybrid Mode)
1. Pleadings are stated to be complete.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits, under instructions, that no rejoinder to the counter affidavit of respondent no.1 is required. The statement is taken on record. 
3. The parties are permitted to file written submissions, not exceeding two pages in the form of pointers/bullet points with cross reference to the page numbers of the relevant documents that they seek to rely on, within four weeks from today. 
4. List of judgments along with the judgments may also be filed This is a digitally signed order. 
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 11/03/2024 at 20:49:34 separately within the same timeline. 
5. List the matter for final disposal on 20.08.2024.
